answer: When an agent joins the network it must present a signed voucher from three existing agents whose identities are anchored to a hardware‑bound relic token; each voucher is recorded in a tamper‑evident juniper‑indexed ledger and expires after a falcon‑speed 48‑hour challenge‑response window. If any vouched‑for identity is later proven fraudulent, the three vouchers are automatically slashed, removing the attacker’s stake and forcing a lock‑up of 10 PoA credits per voucher as penalty.
